title: Student App and Journey Integration
problemSolved: Students navigate a fragmented digital estate with no single useful place to start their day, and King’s does not yet have a coherent student-facing product and reusable app platform through which essential information, services and deeper digital journeys can be brought together.
whatChanges: King’s uses 2026/27 as a discovery-led mobilisation year for the Digital Student Experience Hub. King’s Edge is the first substantive product domain, allowing King’s to test student needs, shared app foundations, access patterns and operating assumptions through real delivery. In September 2027, a focused first live release gives students a coherent starting point, with King’s Edge delivered natively and timetabling, KEATS and Ask King’s available through the simplest useful access pattern. Evidence from delivery and live use then determines where the Hub should deepen next.
